direction: Establish a baseline run of the static parallel-merge CVRP heuristic using score_merge_static, focusing on whether static merge ordering alone produces competitive route merges within the 25 ms budget.

operations.mechanism: Only cvrp_parallel_merge_static with postprocess_mode none is allowed. With no previous round summary or open hypotheses, the safest informative action is to instantiate the allowed baseline and collect score evidence for later refinement. The static score_merge_static should be evaluated directly so subsequent rounds can adjust merge criteria or construction priorities if baseline quality is weak.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: A static merge score with parallel route construction should yield a stable baseline; because this is the first round with no archive feedback, the main value is measuring baseline quality and identifying whether merge scoring is the bottleneck before considering parameter changes or postprocessing.
